q: How many continents are on planet Earth? (P6)
explain: The seven continents are Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania/Australia, and South America.

q: Which is the largest continent in the world by both area and population? (P6)
explain: Asia covers over 44 million km² and hosts over 4.5 billion people.

q: Which is the largest ocean in the world covering over 30% of the Earth's surface? (P6)
explain: The Pacific Ocean is the world's largest and deepest body of water.

q: The international organization formed in 1945 to maintain global peace and security is the ____. (P6)
explain: The UN was created after WWII with 193 member states.

q: The regional economic union of 15 West African states is called ____. (P6)
explain: The Economic Community of West African States was founded in 1975 in Lagos.

q: The African Union (AU) headquarters is located in ____. (P6)
explain: The AU is headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
